rmReject.operation: Return to ARM with fields to correct; notify ARM & RM

rmFinalize.operation: Finalize proposal; update application if needed; attach additional docs

thReject.operation: Send back to RM for correction; notify RM (CC ARM)

thApprove.operation: Record recommendation; assign recommender; update application if needed

cboReject.operation: Send back to Team Head/Business Lead for correction

cboSubmitToCrm.operation: Provide recommendation and submit to CRM; route: if Fresh/Name Clearance -> HoCRM only; else HoCRM CC Team Head and CC Credit Manager

assignTeamHeadCrm.operation: HoCRM or TH-CRM assigns Team Head, CRM

assignCreditManager.operation: Assigned Team Head, CRM assigns Credit Manager

cmRecommend.operation: Send to Team Head–CRM for decision

thcrmSendBack.operation: Send back to RM for correction
